mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.nocode_biz_file_mark (user_id, object_id, entry_id, mark_type, creator, updater) VALUES (#{userId}, #{objectId}, #{entryId}, 'FAVORITE', #{actor}, #{actor}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, entry_id, mark_type) WHERE deleted = 0 DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO public.nocode_biz_file_mark (user_id, object_id, entry_id, mark_type, access_time, creator, updater) VALUES (#{userId}, #{objectId}, #{entryId}, 'RECENT', now(), #{actor}, #{actor}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, entry_id, mark_type) WHERE deleted = 0 DO UPDATE SET access_time = now(), updater = #{actor}, update_time = now()
